title: backupWithRclone configuration
description: Configuration for source directories, destination prefixes, and exclusions.

exclude_dirs.description: Directory names (glob patterns like .DS*) to exclude.

rclone_destination_prefix.description: Destination prefix to which each target directory is appended.

dirs.description: Source directories and their optional target directories.

target_dir.description: Target directory relative to each destination prefix. If omitted, the application uses the basename of source_dir.

exclude_files.description: Filenames (glob patterns like *.txt) to exclude when syncing source_dir

exclude_dirs.description: Directory names (glob patterns like .DS*) to exclude when syncing source_dir

rclone_params.description: Extra parameters for rclone specific to this directory

copy_links.description: Copy content of links (not just the link themselves
